_note: Pirate servers are rarely present in the Valve master. Working sources for them: (1) seeds.txt with your own addresses; (2) urls - links to any monitorings/APIs from which ip:port is extracted with a regex; (3) masters - masters of non-Steam builds; if you know their host:port, add them here.
gms_note: The CSPro client (pirate) does not use the Valve UDP master: it sends POST / HTTP/1.1 to mscf1.cs-css.com:8880 (backups mscf2/mscf3.cs-css.com:8880) with User-Agent 'Valve/Steam HTTP Client 1.0'; the body is compressed+serialized (GSM_PACKET_COMPRESSED|SERIALIZED), the format is closed. It can be bypassed via harvest_client.py - it reads the already-received list directly from the memory of the running game.
